# `intent todo`

**Generated by `intent/st/ST0056/parity/tools/gen_reference.sh` at 2026-09-11 20:23Z. Do not edit -- re-run it.**

A flat DOING / TODO / DONE view of steel threads and work packages

|                                      |                                                          |
| ------------------------------------ | -------------------------------------------------------- |
| Revision this describes              | `1c55a34853449be626399b513d4674080d5e0e52` (`1c55a3485`) |
| Release presence is reported against | `v3.0.1`                                                 |

**The register is a declaration, not a behaviour claim.** The command surface is built from `surface/dispatch-table.json`, so the register at a revision states what that revision exposes. It does not state that any of it works. Where this page and your binary disagree, **your binary is right**.

**No exit codes are listed per command.** The register's per-command exit tables are measurements of _v2_, and v3 does not reproduce them everywhere, so they are not published here as v3's contract. Every command follows the one surface-wide contract on the [index](index.md#exit-codes).

## The commands

| Command               | What it does                                                   | In v3.0.1 | Reads or writes | Undo       |
| --------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------- | --------- | --------------- | ---------- |
| `intent todo`         | Show intent/todo.md (generates it if absent)                   | yes       | mutate          | idempotent |
| `intent todo list`    | Show intent/todo.md (generates it if absent)                   | yes       | mutate          | idempotent |
| `intent todo update`  | Regenerate intent/todo.md from current status                  | yes       | mutate          | idempotent |
| `intent todo done`    | Mark a thread/WP done (via intent st/wp done), then regenerate | yes       | mutate          | reversible |
| `intent todo notdone` | Reopen a thread/WP to WIP, then regenerate                     | yes       | mutate          | reversible |
| `intent todo toggle`  | Flip done/not-done, then regenerate                            | yes       | mutate          | reversible |

## `intent todo`

Show intent/todo.md (generates it if absent)

```
intent todo [<command>] [flags]
```

|                 |            |
| --------------- | ---------- |
| In `v3.0.1`     | yes        |
| Reads or writes | mutate     |
| Undo            | idempotent |
| Over MCP        | yes        |

**Arguments**

| Argument  | Type         | Required | Values | Notes |
| --------- | ------------ | -------- | ------ | ----- |
| `command` | `subcommand` | no       |        | list  |

**Flags**

| Flag       | Takes                  | Default    | What it does                                    |
| ---------- | ---------------------- | ---------- | ----------------------------------------------- |
| `--json`   | no                     |            | Emit the DOING/TODO/DONE view as JSON on stdout |
| `--format` | `<terminal\|md\|json>` | `terminal` | Output format                                   |

**Exit codes** follow the surface-wide contract on the [index](index.md#exit-codes) (INV-04). `intent todo --help`, and your own binary, are the authority on this verb.

## `intent todo done`

Mark a thread/WP done (via intent st/wp done), then regenerate

```
intent todo done [<specifier>] [flags]
```

|                 |            |
| --------------- | ---------- |
| In `v3.0.1`     | yes        |
| Reads or writes | mutate     |
| Undo            | reversible |
| Over MCP        | no         |

**Arguments**

| Argument    | Type         | Required | Values | Notes                                    |
| ----------- | ------------ | -------- | ------ | ---------------------------------------- |
| `specifier` | `st-id[/NN]` | no       |        | omitted when --flush or --prune is given |

**Flags**

| Flag      | Takes | Default | What it does                                              |
| --------- | ----- | ------- | --------------------------------------------------------- |
| `--flush` | no    |         | Advance the DONE watermark to now, clearing the DONE view |
| `--prune` | no    |         | Emit the DONE items for archiving, then flush             |

**Exit codes** follow the surface-wide contract on the [index](index.md#exit-codes) (INV-04). `intent todo done --help`, and your own binary, are the authority on this verb.

## Refusals

**There is no per-command refusal list, because the register does not carry one.** A row declares its path, arguments, flags, target, disposition, recoverability, MCP exposure and read-or-mutate, and nothing structural about what it refuses.

The estate-wide roster of refusal variants is in [what Intent ships at this revision](cut-surface.md), taken from a roster that declares itself exhaustive and is checked as one. **It is not attributed to commands anywhere**, and attributing it by reading the variant names would be a guess dressed as a reference.
